narrative: Anthropic attaches explicit numbers to its safety interventions in the Fable 5 system card - under 5% of sessions trigger fallback routing of sensitive intents, and silent self-degradation on frontier-LLM work touches about 0.03% of traffic. Publishing quantified intervention rates inside a governance disclosure is the measurable, numeric-threshold framing the thesis expects labs to standardize on.
remaining_gap: These are intervention-rate metrics, not the fatalities/dollar harm thresholds the prediction anchors on, and no other Tier-1 lab has published equivalent numbers.
